response.sql: WITH per_nat AS (SELECT c.nationality AS nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT c.constructorId) AS constructor_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, constructor_count, constructor_count - (SELECT AVG(constructor_count * 1.0) FROM per_nat) AS diff_from_avg FROM per_nat

assumptions.assumption: Only constructors that have at least one constructorResults row are counted. Nationalities with no such constructors do not appear and are excluded from the average.
The average is the unweighted mean of the per-nationality distinct constructor counts. The difference is count minus average, so positive means above average.
A NULL nationality, if any exists, is treated as its own group.
